body.message:
As per your request, please find below the rates for Executive Residences 2 - One Bedroom Apartment

Stay Period: 10th Aug to 09th Sep
Total Duration: 30 nights
Total Rate: AED 6,500

Please note that a refundable security deposit of AED 2,000 is required.

The refundable damage deposit will be processed within 7 working days after check-out and will be refunded to the same card used for the original payment.

Please note that a 3.1% card processing fee will apply to the rent payment if you choose to pay via the payment link.

Alternatively, you may make the payment via bank transfer or cash, in which case no additional fees will be charged.
